FN-2YV9IS-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 99
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/04/2023
Senate Bill 99 as introduced would increase the mileage reimbursement rate paid to jurors from
$0.05 per mile to $0.50 per mile, which according to the Administrative Office of Courts
(AOC), would increase the obligations of AOC, funded by the State General Fund, by an
estimated $1.4 million annually based on the mileage reimbursed in fiscal year 2022.
Page 1

FN-2YV9IS-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 99
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/05/2023
Senate Bill 99 as passed the Senate would (1) require the Alabama Supreme Court to establish
per diem and mileage rates for jurors by order or rule of the court, and (2) repeal the current $10
per diem and $0.05 mileage rate.
According to the Administrative Office of Courts (AOC), the new rates proposed the Supreme
Court would be $0.625 per mile and $25 per day. Using Fiscal Year 2022 data jury data, these
rates would increase jury expenses by and estimated $3,795,000.
The Fiscal Year 2024 State General Fund appropriation bill (House Bill 124), as engrossed,
includes an appropriation of $3,795,000 to the Unified Judicial System for a juror pay increase.
